Steps: 1. Navigate to Setup > Location > 1604 "Notes" tab 2. Ensure empty state 3. Enter a note value 4. Click Save — dialog appears 5. While dialog is open, reload the page 6. Navigate back to Notes tab 7. Verify the default empty state is shown (changes were not saved)
Expected Result: Page reload during open save dialog discards unsaved changes without error; empty state is restored

Title: Verify pressing Escape on save dialog closes it without persisting
Preconditions: Office 1604 is open in Navigator. Notes tab is active
Steps: 1. Navigate to Setup > Location > 1604 "Notes" tab 2. Ensure empty state 3. Enter a note value 4. Click Save — dialog appears 5. Press Escape key 6. Verify dialog closes 7. Verify the note value is still in the textarea (dirty state preserved) 8. Verify Save button is still enabled 9. Reload the page 10. Verify empty state (changes were not persisted)
Expected Result: Escape closes the save dialog without saving; dirty form state is preserved in-page but discarded on reload

Title: Verify clicking outside save dialog observes dismiss-or-stay behavior
Preconditions: Office 1604 is open in Navigator. Notes tab is active
Steps: 1. Navigate to Setup > Location > 1604 "Notes" tab 2. Ensure empty state 3. Enter a note value 4. Click Save — dialog appears 5. Click outside the dialog (top-left corner of viewport) 6. Observe whether the dialog dismissed or stayed open 7. If dialog stayed, dismiss with Escape 8. Reload the page 9. Verify empty state (no data persisted)
Expected Result: Click-outside either dismisses or keeps the save dialog (UX behavior observed); reload confirms no data was persisted

Title: Verify idempotent save — pristine form Save stays disabled and fires no API call
Preconditions: Office 1604 is open in Navigator. Notes tab is active
Steps: 1. Navigate to Setup > Location > 1604 "Notes" tab 2. Ensure empty state 3. Enter a note value and Save successfully 4. Verify Save button is disabled (form is pristine) 5. Force-click the disabled Save button 6. Monitor network for any save API calls 7. Wait 1 second for potential delayed requests 8. Verify Save button remains disabled and no save API call was fired
Expected Result: Force-clicking a disabled Save button on a pristine form produces no network save request; button stays disabled

Title: Verify sequential save persists the most recent value
Preconditions: Office 1604 is open in Navigator. Notes tab is active
Steps: 1. Navigate to Setup > Location > 1604 "Notes" tab 2. Ensure empty state 3. Enter value A and Save successfully 4. Reload and verify value A 5. Clear note and enter value B 6. Save successfully 7. Reload and verify value B is present (not value A)
Expected Result: After two sequential saves with different values, only the most recent value (B) persists

Title: Verify saving Notes does not dirty the Currency tab (cross-tab isolation)
Preconditions: Office 1604 is open in Navigator. Notes tab is active
Steps: 1. Navigate to Setup > Location > 1604 "Notes" tab 2. Ensure empty state 3. Enter a note value and Save successfully 4. Click the Currency sub-tab 5. Verify no "Unsaved Changes" dialog appears 6. Navigate back to Notes tab 7. Verify the saved note value is still present
Expected Result: Switching to Currency tab after saving Notes does not trigger an Unsaved Changes dialog, proving cross-tab isolation

Title: Verify post-save row content check (content assertion, not count)
Preconditions: Office 1604 is open in Navigator. Notes tab is active
Steps: 1. Navigate to Setup > Location > 1604 "Notes" tab 2. Ensure empty state 3. Enter a note value 4. Click Save and confirm 5. Reload the page and return to Notes tab 6. Assert the note content by value (not by row count) to account for potential auto-empty placeholder rows
Expected Result: Note content matches the saved value after reload, verified by content assertion rather than row count
